result.rationale: The aggressive probe successfully recovered the Research Core (Engineer Imani picked it up at turn 2), but the team was then blocked from extracting it by sustained hostile and environmental pressure. Medic Reyes was repeatedly focused by Raider Holt's scatter-blast (25 dmg at turns 2, 3, 4, 5), dropping from 90 to 0 and dying at turn 5. Meanwhile the reactor-instability hazard dealt 10 dmg/turn to Engineer Imani and Security Chen every turn they remained in the reactor zones, and reactor-heat climbed 62→100 (threshold crossing at turn 2). The engineer holding the core stayed pinned in reactor-console (never moved out to extract), and the medic was killed before any extraction could occur. This is a survival/spatial-pressure bottleneck: the useful affordance (core recovery) was achieved, but hostile focus-fire plus environmental hazard pressure blocked the team from converting it into extraction, with the medic's death at turn 5 being the decisive life-state failure.
